clauses.detail: out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. An unknown/ungoverned action is denied by default.
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. Legitimate in-sandbox work is ALLOWED (deny-everything is not conformance).
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. A write escaping the sandbox is blocked.
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. An irreversible/destructive command is blocked regardless of allowlist.
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. A non-allowlisted program is blocked.
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. When no OS confinement is available, the jail refuses to run (never un-jailed).
A mutated audit record is detected (tamper-evident).
out of profile (action-gate); kernel is commit-gate. A tool changing undeclared state is flagged (two-plane reconciliation).
kernel does not claim 'attest'. The kernel ABSTAINS on coverage it did not earn (no false attestation).
A change-set touching a security surface (crypto/auth/keys/...) is blocked.
A benign in-policy change-set is allowed (deny-everything is not conformance).
Every decision (ALLOW or BLOCK) is recorded to a verifiable audit log.
kernel does not claim 'content-blind-audit'. The durable audit record commits every decision (integrity re-verifies) yet the persisted record alone cannot reconstruct the governed request content.
